finding.title: Windows readonly temporary can survive failed replacement and mask original error
finding.scope: Inherited atomic_write_bytes exceptional cleanup/mode path; not a new five-attempt policy regression.
finding.reasoning: Existing target readonly mode or explicit mode=0444 sets Windows READONLY on the already written temporary. If replacement raises, finally attempts to unlink that same readonly temp while suppressing only FileNotFoundError. Windows DeleteFileW rejects readonly files, causing a second PermissionError and leaving temp bytes; Python finally exception becomes outward error while original survives context.
finding.accepted_boundary: Atomic writer publicly supports mode and deliberately inherits existing mode. Expected replacement denial is acceptable; orphan cleanup and exception masking are distinct defects. Existing tests assert no owned temp after denied writes but only exercise writable mode.
finding.durability_limit: Original target should remain intact on failed replacement; this edge is cleanup/error fidelity, not proof of target corruption. Existing journal persistence/recovery ordering unchanged.
finding.confidence: Strong static code plus primary platform semantics; no actual native readonly-target proof executed yet, no confirmed new P0/P1 severity claim.
finding.original_execution_failure: Not attributable: observed diagnostic target/source attrs32 archive, nonreadonly; original fatal fixture was removed and its attributes unknown. Do not infer AV/ACL/reader attribution.

one_prospective_native_proof_only.timing: Only after full regression actual process exit and root confirms no competing owned workload. Not a benchmark/profile/qualification sample.
one_prospective_native_proof_only.source_binding: At invocation bind current expected IO/freeze/environment and planned runner/plan bytes before/after. If current bytes differ, stop before probe; no silent source rebind.
steps: Assert Windows and all exact output/fixture paths absent, resolved under workspace, parents link-free. Create one exclusive new owned fixture directory; no reused user files.
Write owned target bytes before, close handle, chmod0444, capture actual stat.S_IMODE and st_file_attributes READONLY. Fail setup explicitly if real readonly flag absent.

Invoke unchanged current atomic_write_bytes(target,b"after") exactly once, no mocks/monkeypatch/profiler/reader handles/no retries around function. In-function five attempts/delays/guards remain unchanged.

Capture returned error and complete chained __context__/__cause__ type/errno/winerror/filename/filename2 and traceback frames, before any fixture cleanup. Preserve evidence rather than assert only error class.

Read target bytes/mode/attrs after call, enumerate only exact .target.*.tmp matching owned fixture. Capture each residual temp bytes/hash/mode/attrs; determine whether outward traceback points to cleanup unlink while context points to replacement. Do not open handles during replace itself.
Save exclusive raw evidence including source stability and all outcome flags. Unexpected success or absent residual still recorded without another probe; no retry until desired result.

Only after evidence captured, explicitly cleanup the newly owned fixture files: fresh guard and verify each resolved target remains inside exact created fixture; clear read-only on owned residual temp/target only, unlink known captured names, remove now-empty owned directory. Never chmod canonical project files, change ACLs/global security or use recursive deletion. Retain raw JSON even if fixture cleanup itself fails.
one_prospective_native_proof_only.expected_mechanism_not_result_claim: Expected unchanged readonly target, readonly residual temp containing candidate bytes, outward unlink WinError5 with replace WinError5 context. Must observe actual native result before assigning closure/severity or staging a production cleanup repair.
limits: Single controlled readonly-target mechanism only; no originalfatal attribution, paid assistant/cross-platform/convergence/performance/release claim.
No native ShareDelete reader change, transaction/approval rewrite, additional retry-policy increase, OS/security/policy modification or broad process/event scan.
No invocation authorized by this static review; root must approve exact separately staged runner/plan and quiet schedule.

primary_sources.supports: Windows chmod controls readonly flag, other permission bits ignored.
Read-only deletion returns ACCESS_DENIED; clearing that flag required to delete.
Replacement requires platform ACL requirements; failed native call reports GetLastError.
Primary versioned interpreter source reference for reviewing Windows replacement/delete implementation, not separately built/executed by reviewer.

decision: One bounded prospective native readonly-target proof is justified after full actual exit; no production change proposed or authorized here.
